statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6460 (PostgreSQL type confusion after ALTER ... SET DATA TYPE executes arbitrary code) in 16.16 on the PostgreSQL 16 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6460/ lists 16.16 as the fixed release for major version 16 (versions before 16.16 are affected), and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix is a series of commits on the REL_16_STABLE branch tagged Security: CVE-2026-6460, all in the REL_16_16 release tag and not in REL_16_15, among them https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/0c8ffa1ad2f44be4b058a3ec96d9cb0c71f2593f (attribute versioning to prevent unsafe deforming of stale row values), https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/0453c553952116c6b8ac5f155f616a13eef0980e (checks for cross-rowtype deforming and conversions), https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/7f8be5d19f326a820ec05bbb67354615946c9f8a (PL/pgSQL checks that source and target records are compatible) and https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/e5c581cd4d7482ad1b0e265ab903d0d4b35e9dbd (ALTERing a column type is refused by default when other objects depend on it). The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes. It lists CVE-2026-6460 under its 16.16-r0 secfixes. We checked the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, in every postgresql16 build published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI package repository as of 2026-11-28, on both x86_64 and aarch64 (package checksums verified against the package index): 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0 report PostgreSQL 16.13, 16.14 and 16.15 and are affected, while 16.16-r0 reports PostgreSQL 16.16 and carries the fix. As a check, the server binary contains the error message 'using outdated tuple descriptor when deforming row type', which these commits add, and the PL/pgSQL module, /usr/lib/postgresql16/plpgsql.so, contains the message 'assigned value is incompatible with the variable's type', in 16.16-r0 on both architectures, and the same files in 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0 do not. 16.16-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6460, type confusion after ALTER ... SET DATA TYPE and similar DDL, where stale typed values left in data dictionary entries, PL/pgSQL variables and elsewhere let an object creator execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, in 17.12. Within major version 17, releases before 17.12 are affected. https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6460/, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/. Debian fixed it for trixie in postgresql-17 17.12-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6625-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-6460. The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix, and 17.12-0 is the lowest published build that does. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0.
